# Filler

> Filler (https://filler.live) is a free Chrome extension that fills web forms from a profile you save once. It reads each question, not just the field name, so it fills job applications, Google Forms, signups and registrations. No account: the profile stays in your browser. You check every field and press Submit yourself; Filler never submits and never touches file uploads.

## Pricing

- Filler: free, no account, no daily limit.
- Job Hunt Pass (coming soon): AI drafts for custom application questions ("Why this role?") from the job post and your profile. $5 for 30 days, never auto-renews. https://filler.live/pass

## Install

- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/filler/dlopehidojlicdenpoadbnkgjiaoimkm
